content: {"episode_id":"ep-05125","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope (R55) in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
